WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2023-12-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), diffs AS (
  SELECT month, gross_revenue, gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change
  FROM monthly
)

sql:
SELECT dc.name, ROUND((SUM(oi.sale_price - ii.cost))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
orders_per_user AS (
  SELECT c.id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = c.id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS share
FROM orders_per_user

SELECT u.traffic_source, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id),0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS total_users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN u.id END)::float / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS share
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi
  ON oi.user_id = u.id
  AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
  AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS t2,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) AS t3
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t3-t2))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS p90
FROM per_user

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT f.user_id,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.order_time - f.order_time))/86400.0 AS days_diff
  FROM ranked f
  JOIN ranked s ON s.user_id = f.user_id AND s.rn = 2
  WHERE f.rn = 1
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM pairs

WITH oi AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time, SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM oi
)
SELECT
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) -
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1) AS diff

WITH order_times AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM order_times
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MIN(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_order,
         MIN(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS p95_days
FROM pivoted

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Search'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot
WHERE second_order IS NOT NULL
